discovery: Legal compliance deferred until traction justifies lawyer costs
context: Lumo review flagged ToS/copyright concerns as pre-release blockers
decision: Ship with basic README disclaimer only; defer full LEGAL.md and compliance review until >1000 users or revenue
reasoning: Current AI open source landscape: everyone ships fast, worries about lawyers later. Vaporware doesn't need lawyers. Product-market fit first, compliance second.
risk_acceptance: Pre-traction ToS violations acceptable cost of validation; will formalize if traction emerges
mitigation: Basic 'use at your own risk' disclaimer in README; no redistribution of base model weights; transformative use argument documented
